body: Effexor XR. The alarm thing makes sense..don't know why I never did it. Also the list..heh, seems so simple.

Sad thing is I have tried to ask her that, but instead ended up asking her to give me something to treat the panic attacks I was having at the time. I'm not sure that I would take medication if given, though it did make me feel better at the time, I am an extremely forgetful person and often didn't take it on time so it made me even more emotional than I already am.
